newsitem.title: UK: TransCo price probe extended to May 31 - Ofgas.
newsitem.headline: TransCo price probe extended to May 31 - Ofgas.

text.p: British watchdog Ofgas said on Wednesday it agreed to an extension of a regulatory inquiry into proposed price controls on BG Plc's TransCo gas pipeline operator.
Ofgas said the Monopolies and Mergers Commission planned to extend its inquiry into the watchdog's proposed price controls until May 31 from April 14.
A spokesman for the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) said the delay would allow the commission extra time to consider extensive new information supplied over the last few weeks.
The delay was unrelated to the upcoming parliamentary election on May 1, he said.
The MMC has been investigating Ofgas' price control proposals since October when they were rejected by BG, which was at the time still called British Gas.
BG said the proposed pricing regime was too harsh, leaving it with insufficient funds to maintain an efficient and safe pipeline network.
The proposals, which seek a one-off cut in TransCo's charges to gas suppliers of 20 percent, would trim cash flow by at least 400 million stg per year, BG claimed earlier.
Investors, meanwhile, fear that implementation of the proposals would lead to a BG dividend cut of some 10 percent.
